history.prompt: Matte clay 3D render of a small mechanical assembly, studio render on a neutral seamless backdrop. A modular mechanical junction block with a single thick input routing into multiple diverging parallel output channels. Three recognizable engineered parts: a housing, a central distribution hub, and interlocking cable connectors. Matte surfaces with molding seams and soft contact shadows. Single soft key light, matte muted palette of soft gray and telecom orange. Generous negative space, clean editorial elegance.

Cinematic film still, anamorphic 35mm wide establishing composition. A massive industrial fiber optic routing bay inside an atmospheric data center, heavy brushed-steel server racks receding into deep shadow on the right. Thick bundles of glowing amber and teal fiber optic cables branch out from a central hardware switch in a complex, parallel fan-out configuration. Deep atmospheric volumetric haze, a single strong practical light source throwing dramatic directional shadows across the metallic rack panels. Restrained teal-and-amber color palette, quiet editorial restraint, moody architectural lighting.

style_when: the article is a purely conceptual synthesis or policy dilemma where no physical facility, machine, or supply chain exists, and an elegant abstract paper silhouette states the idea. Never reach for paper collage when the story describes physical manufacturing, freight, energy, hardware, or heavy infrastructure — use cinematic still or telephoto industry instead
prompt: Minimalist editorial cut-paper collage of three distinct mechanical routing pathways—one fan-out, one straight sequential line, one cyclical loop—layered deliberately over a textured grid paper surface. Hand-torn rag paper with visible fibre, physical cast shadows under each crisp cut-out object layer, raking warm directional light. Muted modern editorial palette with one accent color, crisp clean edges, generous negative space, halftone newsprint texture. Asymmetric composition off-centre right.
negative_prompt: text, letters, numbers, wordmarks, signage, UI, watermark, logo
